build_descriptor_from_proto: build a protobuf Descriptor from a DescriptorProto using MakeDescriptor with a package name
create_field_descriptor: create a FieldDescriptor for a proto field with type, label, number, and default value
create_enum_descriptor: create an EnumDescriptor with named values and their corresponding numeric values
review_descriptor_fields: review a Descriptor to list all fields, nested types, and enum types by name
test_proto_type_to_cpp: test FieldDescriptor.ProtoTypeToCppProtoType to convert a Python proto type to its C++ type
